title_en: Building Access Restrictions for the 2027 Graduate School of Engineering Practice Admissions Screening
summary: Floors 4 and 5 of Building 38 will be closed to everyone not involved in the admissions examination of the Graduate School of Engineering Practice on Friday, 23 October 2026, from 11:30 to 18:00. Students are asked to cooperate so that the admissions screening can proceed smoothly.
applies_to: All persons other than those involved in the Graduate School of Engineering Practice admissions examination.

dates.what: Building access restriction period (Building 38, 4th and 5th floors)

steps: Do not enter the 4th or 5th floor of Building 38 between 11:30 and 18:00 on Friday, 23 October 2026, unless you are involved in the Graduate School of Engineering Practice admissions examination.
translation:
Building Access Restrictions for the 2027 Graduate School of Engineering Practice Admissions Screening

Posted: 4 September 2026

Please be advised of the following building access restrictions for the admissions screening of new students to the Graduate School of Engineering Practice [공학전문대학원] for the 2027 academic year. We ask for your cooperation so that the admissions screening can proceed smoothly.

A. Date and time of restriction: Friday, 23 October 2026, 11:30–18:00

B. Restricted area: 4th and 5th floors of Building 38 [38동]

C. Persons restricted: Everyone other than those involved in the Graduate School of Engineering Practice admissions examination.

End of notice.
